evidence.quote: Incumbents can’t simply tear down their UIs and business models to pivot
categories that have historically monetized gatekept institutional knowledge will be most susceptible
Law is obviously at risk (Harvey and Legora are exploding)

text: Mignano argues agents will reorganize markets as the internet and mobile did, because incumbents can't tear down their UIs and business models, and categories that monetize gatekept institutional knowledge (law, medicine, personal finance) are most exposed.
